action_add_import: Add an @AGENTS.md line at the top of CLAUDE.md so Claude reads AGENTS.md too; the rest of CLAUDE.md stays as it is.
action_copy_to_claude: Copy %s to %s so Claude sees it; this machine cannot make links, so the check compares the copies.
action_copy_to_codex: Copy %s to %s so Codex sees it; this machine cannot make links, so the check compares the copies.
action_create_agents: Move CLAUDE.md's rules into a new AGENTS.md, and leave CLAUDE.md as one line that imports it.
action_link_skill: Link %s to %s so Claude sees the skill Codex already sees.
action_move_skill: Move %s to %s and leave a link in its place, so Codex sees it too.
action_replace_copy: Replace the identical copy %s with a link to %s.
answer_unreadable: clawdline: the answer was not readable; run `clawdline project unify` to see what disk holds.
apply_hint: Nothing has been changed. `clawdline project unify --apply` performs the %d actions above.
apply_unknown: — whether it applied is unknown; run `clawdline project unify` to see.
claude_only_files: Read by Claude only, never changed here: %s
claude_only_lines: Lines in CLAUDE.md that Codex does not see:
conflict_agents_link: AGENTS.md is a link to %s; unify does not follow or change it.
conflict_claude_link: CLAUDE.md is a link to %s; unify does not follow or change it.
conflict_claude_only_lines: Codex does not see these lines; move the shared ones into AGENTS.md.
conflict_claude_rules_unchecked: This Claude rules file could not be checked.
conflict_file_too_large: This file is larger than unify reads; check it on the machine.
conflict_import_without_agents: CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md, which does not exist; write the shared rules there.
conflict_name_before_link: Something that is not this skill already uses this name; move it before linking the skill here.
conflict_name_before_share: Something that is not this skill already uses this name; move it before sharing the skill.
conflict_skill_differs: This skill differs from %s; keep one version in %s and remove the other.
conflict_skill_link: This skill is a link to %s; unify does not follow or change it.
conflict_skill_link_elsewhere: This skill is a link to %s, not to %s; unify does not follow or change it.
conflict_skill_too_large: This skill has more files than unify compares.
conflict_skill_unreadable: This skill could not be read.
conflict_skills_link: This skills directory, or the one above it, is a link; unify does not follow or change it.
conflict_skills_too_large: This skills directory has more entries than unify reads.
conflict_skills_unreadable: This skills directory could not be read.
conflict_utf8_unreadable: This file could not be read as UTF-8 text.
conflicts_heading: For you to resolve (unify does not change these)
daemon_unreadable: the daemon's answer could not be read: %w
flag_check: print only the status and drift; exit 0 unified, 1 drifting, 3 unknown
not_git_repository: %s is not inside a Git repository
plan_part_unreadable: clawdline: part of the plan could not be read, so nothing was applied.
plan_unreadable: clawdline: the plan was not readable:
project_list_unreadable: the daemon's Project list was not readable: %w
project_not_listed: this machine does not list %s as a Project; run `clawdline project add %s` first
skills_header: NAME	SEEN NOW BY	WILL BE SEEN BY	WHERE
